CLOSE_PAINT_GLSL

GLSL helper library for the close-button look — shared between CLOSE_BUTTON_FS (the dedicated close widget) and the burger's open state, which morphs into this exact control and must paint it pixel-identically (turquoise pour, foam crest, rising bubbles, inset rim, rotating X strokes, click shockwave).

lkClosePaint works in "close pixels": the same pixel basis the close widget's backing store uses (CSS box × capped DPR). Callers on supersampled buffers divide fragcoord/res by their supersample factor before calling so one unit here is always one close-widget pixel.

  • @param pRel Fragment position relative to the disc center, in close px.
  • @param minRes Shorter canvas dimension in close px — derives the disc
  • @returns vec4 — premultiplied=false rgba; alpha is the disc's borderAA
